title: Making firemen's hats and the volunteer fire companies
summary: Laine, a member of three fire companies, still makes hats for volunteers and plans to march in the Spring Fiesta.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: What else do you do now besides just drinking and having a good time? What else do you do?
Oh, I'm past my time making them hats now. Now I'm doing it again.
Making those fire hats for the volunteer fire department? Yeah.

You see, those boys over the river, I belong to three fire companies. Uh-huh. See? And them boys over the river, I made them all, about a hundred of them hats. See? They asked me to make some more for them. And they probably might use them around the last of May. See? They said, well, I'll try to do the best I can for you. Well, I've seen them the day of the parade on Canal Street.
Is that right? The Spring Fiesta. He was in there.
Is that right? Yeah. They were out too. Oh, I'll be there.
The devil. He can't hardly see. But he goes.
Go get my hat and be, mother.

He goes. My granddaughter, he was going out there. He was sick the other day. And his legs couldn't carry him. And he had his stick in it. She said, I'm a son of a fucker. She said, he'll go if he's got a drop.
